northStar.name: Operational Ledger
northStar.summary: A warm, official, paper-and-ink operations interface for payroll-grade attendance records.

display.purpose: Highest page title only. Avoid inside dense admin panels.

title.purpose: Card titles, form groups, table panels, and modal titles.

body.purpose: Readable prose, helper text, and operational descriptions.

label.purpose: Field labels, metadata, badges, compact controls, and table labels.

elevation.philosophy: Flat by default. Use tonal layers and borders before shadows.

rules: Avoid flashing, pulsing, glow, and page-load choreography.

componentRules.buttons: 6px radius, restrained fills, visible focus, 44px minimum touch height for employee actions.
componentRules.tables: Readable density, sticky headers where useful, status text plus icon, row dividers over color fills.
componentRules.navigation: Compact side navigation with text labels. No thick side stripes.
componentRules.forms: Clear labels, visible required fields, specific validation messages, keyboard support.
componentRules.clockSurface: Large action targets with current user, branch, date, time, status, and next action visible.

rules: Operations Green marks action or selection. It is not decoration.
Status color must always be paired with visible text and, where useful, an icon.
Cards are only for real units of work.
Arabic and English are first-class experiences.
donts: Marketing-style hero sections inside admin pages
Too many gradients, glows, and empty cards
